_comment: Where a service's own records live: its mount, then its NAME.
Two languages need this natively — Python services publish their own
colca-service publishes it for those that cannot (plugins/uns.ServiceContext).
The name segment is what keeps two services apart. Without it every
UNPLACED service on a node writes its retained registration to one topic
and erases the others — the last to start becomes the only service the
node appears to have, and any catalogue naming one of the rest parks
forever waiting for a service that never comes back.
